top_signals.title: BADBOX botnet returns with record-breaking 40 billion daily ad requests
top_signals.summary: The BADBOX malware found in a broad range of generic Android TV boxes has returned to large-scale ad-fraud operations following last year's disruptions. [...]

top_signals.title: Argentine Energy Firms Rush to Sell Bonds Before the 2027 Election
top_signals.summary: Argentina’s energy sector is having a banner year. The first half of 2026 saw the South American nation’s best energy trade balance in half a decade as exports boomed thanks to a drop in exports out of the Middle East and strong production numbers out of the Vaca Muerta shale play. And Argentina’s energy export boom isn’t over. This week, major underwriter Banco Santander announced that a wave of dollar bond sales out of Argentina is projected to extend into the first half of 2027 as the nation’s energy sector continues…
